title: Cheaply made
text:
Cheaply made. Ours arrived broken and warped, so it forced me to inspect these extra closely. I found these medallions are made from some pretty cheap and lightweight materials. Plywood might be too nice of a description. The center white material feels almost like a molded cardboard or thick paperboard.
Not all of the holes were punched all the way through on ours either. The outside circle frame (made from inexpensive looking pine wood), also arrived chipped. This trio might look neat from a distance, but up close they look and feel incredibly inexpensive. I should be able to fix them enough to make them hangable, but I shouldn't have too.
I don't usually comment about an item's price, because a "good deal" is subjective. But had I paid the $75 these were listed for at the time of this review, they would have been returned. So even though they are eye-catching and pretty, I can't whole heartedly recommend them.
